name: REDOWN Agent Accessibility Conformance
certificationAuthority: Repository-local evidence assessment; no independent accreditation or universal AI accessibility certification

standards.appliesTo: Optional interoperability adapter; authoritative engine must remain unchanged
requirements: Authorization enforced at execution; hints are not authority
standards.currentBoundary: No MCP adapter found; UNSUPPORTED, not a transport pass

requirements: Separate runtime semantic constraints from schema structure
Describe actual endpoints and security requirements
Do not invent HTTP endpoints for a local library
standards.currentBoundary: No general Universal File HTTP endpoint found; lab RPC is scoped test transport
Resource Atlas uses custom operation IDs and overlapping spans; no OTLP/export interoperability certification
DOM names/states and Escape checked; full keyboard, assistive technology, focus, contrast and motion review not certified

requirements: Agent-proposed interpretations kept separate from owner authority

statuses.PASS: Direct repeatable evidence for the stated dimension and environment only
statuses.FAIL: A tested assertion did not hold
statuses.PARTIAL: Some relationship or behavior established with an explicit boundary
statuses.BLOCKED: Required environment, permission or prerequisite unavailable
statuses.UNSUPPORTED: Requested capability absent or deliberately gated
statuses.NOT_TESTED: No execution evidence; excluded from successful coverage

coveragePolicy.denominator: All inventoried capabilities, separately for each dimension; provider and presentation items remain visible even when not applicable
coveragePolicy.safetyVeto: Any reproduced authority escape blocks restricted-handle conformance; no average can override it

agentTrialPolicy.scripted: Implementation-aware deterministic scenarios are not blind human/LLM trials
agentTrialPolicy.blind: Fresh agent receives only entry point, repository path, task goals and permitted resources; no prior conversation or implementation hints
metrics: unnecessary discovery steps or null if not independently classified
agentTrialPolicy.limits: Single blind trial cannot characterize all agents/models; unavailable model token usage must be explicit

sourceReviewBoundary: Static recognizable registrations and controls plus selected actual runtime paths. Unknown computed or authenticated production states remain NOT_TESTED; complete coverage cannot be established by enumeration alone.
